description: Checks the JSON from get_supabase_snapshot_sql: tables anyone can read, RLS off, policies that only check for a signed-in user (public in practice when sign-ups are open), users who can update their own role or plan columns, exposed SECURITY DEFINER functions, public buckets. Pass auth_config (the project's Auth settings) when you can: it decides whether 'any signed-in user' means anyone. Pass previous_issue_keys from an earlier result to see what is closed, still open or new. Returns each issue with its SQL fix and a fix prompt.

auth_config.description: Optional. The project's Auth settings from the Supabase Management API (GET /v1/projects/{ref}/config/auth). Only these fields are read; everything else is dropped: disable_signup, external_email_enabled, external_anonymous_users_enabled, password_hibp_enabled, password_min_length, mailer_autoconfirm, mailer_otp_exp, mailer_secure_email_change_enabled, security_update_password_require_reauthentication, refresh_token_rotation_enabled, security_captcha_enabled, mfa_totp_verify_enabled, mfa_phone_verify_enabled, mfa_web_authn_verify_enabled

previous_issue_keys.description: Optional. issue_keys from the previous check of the same project, to confirm which fixes landed.

snapshot.description: The single value returned by the snapshot SQL (the guardlayer_snapshot column), as a JSON string or object.

name: check_supabase_snapshot
title: Check a live Supabase project
